issues.issue: Did the Citizenship Judge err in granting citizenship when Mr. Hussein was 111 days short of the residence requirement?
issues.applicant_position: Minister: judge erred by applying the wrong residence test or crediting deemed residence despite 212 days absent; reasons insufficient.
issues.respondent_position: Hussein: evidence supported a centralized-mode-of-living finding given his wife's and sons' continuous residence in Canada.
issues.result_quote: Therefore, considering the above analysis, I must conclude that the Citizenship Judge committed a reviewable error which compels me to annul the decision he rendered in the present case.
